verification_targets.description: Overall Z extent (height) of the completed L-bracket.

functional_requirements: Bracket must be a single rigid right-angle (90 degree) L-shaped part carrying a 10 mm diameter through-hole on the vertical face for fastener mounting.
The through-hole must fully penetrate the vertical plate (through-hole, not blind) so a bolt can pass through.
Overall footprint is defined by width 80 mm, vertical height 60 mm and material thickness 10 mm.
special_features: Through-hole MUST be a single circular hole of MOUNTING_HOLE_DIA = 10 mm (radius MOUNTING_HOLE_RADIUS = 5 mm) on the vertical face; MUST NOT create any additional holes.

Through-hole MUST be positioned MOUNTING_HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET = 20 mm from the top edge of the vertical face and 20 mm from the left vertical edge, i.e. centre at (X = MOUNTING_HOLE_POS_X = -20, Z = MOUNTING_HOLE_POS_Z = 40).

Vertical face MUST be WIDTH_X = 80 mm wide (X) and HEIGHT_Z = 60 mm tall (Z) with THICKNESS = 10 mm, and MUST be joined to the horizontal base along a single 90 degree bend at the rear of the base.
Horizontal base MUST be WIDTH_X = 80 mm (X) by BASE_DEPTH_Y = 60 mm (Y) by THICKNESS = 10 mm (Z), occupying Z = 0 to Z = 10 with the centroid of its bottom face at the origin.
Vertical face MUST NOT overhang or extend beyond the base footprint in +Y; its outer face lies at Y = +30 (Y_MAX) with the inner face at Y = +20.
MUST NOT add any features not stated in the request (no fillets, chamfers, counterbores, ribs, lightening cutouts, or extra holes); plain sharp-edged L-bracket only.

Hole placement in X is asymmetric (20 mm from the left edge only); the hole MUST NOT be duplicated or mirrored to the right edge.

steps.label: Extrude horizontal base plate 80 x 60 x 10 (Z = 0..10)

steps.label: Extrude vertical plate 80 wide x 60 tall x 10 thick at the rear of the base
steps.notes: Sketch plane at world Y = +30 (outer face); 10 mm extrusion toward -Y gives the vertical plate at Y = +20..+30, X = -40..+40, Z = 0..+60. steps.label: Fuse base plate and vertical plate into one water-tight solid

Part request: "Create an L-bracket with overall width 80 mm, height 60 mm, thickness 10 mm, and a 10 mm diameter through-hole centered 20 mm from each adjacent edge on the vertical face."

sketches.notes: Horizontal base plate outline centered on the XY origin: X = -40..+40 (WIDTH_X = 80), Y = -30..+30 (BASE_DEPTH_Y = 60). Extruded +Z by THICKNESS = 10 gives Z = 0..10 with the centroid of the bottom face at the origin.

Custom profile: rectangle 80 wide x 60 tall expressed in sketch-local coordinates (local x = world X, span -40..+40; local y = world Z, span 0..+60). Plane.XZ sketch plane is placed at world Y = +30 (the OUTER face of the vertical plate; offset computed as -Y_MAX = -30.0 because Plane.XZ normal is -Y). Extruding 10 mm along the plane normal (-Y) yields the vertical plate at Y = 20..30, i.e. inner face Y = +20, outer face Y = +30 = Y_MAX, with no overhang past the base footprint.

steps.label: Extrude horizontal base plate 80 x 60 x 10 (Z = 0..10)
steps.notes: Base plate occupies X = -40..+40, Y = -30..+30, Z = 0..10 (80 x 60 x 10). Bottom-face centroid at global origin.

steps.label: Extrude vertical plate 80 wide x 60 tall x 10 thick at the rear of the base
steps.notes: Sketch plane at world Y = +30 (outer face); 10 mm extrusion toward -Y gives the vertical plate at Y = +20..+30, X = -40..+40, Z = 0..+60. The plate deliberately starts at Z = 0 so it overlaps the base volume in the region X = -40..40, Y = 20..30, Z = 0..10, guaranteeing a clean single-body union at the single 90 degree bend.

steps.label: Fuse base plate and vertical plate into one water-tight solid
steps.notes: Fuses along the rear bend; shared overlap volume Y = 20..30, Z = 0..10 prevents any face-only touching and yields exactly one connected solid (bounding box X 80, Y 60, Z 60).

steps.label: 10 mm dia through-hole on the vertical face, 20 mm from left edge and 20 mm from top edge
steps.notes: Through-hole along the Y axis (Cylinder rotated Rot(X=90)), vertical plate spans Y = 20..30 (10 mm thick). Axis passes through X = -20 (20 mm from the left vertical edge at X = -40) and Z = 40 (20 mm below the top edge at Z = 60). Position Y = 25.0 is the mid-thickness of the plate so the bore fully penetrates both faces with overshoot. Exactly ONE hole: asymmetric in X, NOT mirrored or duplicated.

revision_history.note: Initial design: plain sharp-edged L-bracket, base 80 x 60 x 10 (Z = 0..10), vertical plate 80 x 60 x 10 at Y = 20..30, single 10 mm through-hole along Y at (X = -20, Z = 40). No fillets, chamfers, ribs or extra holes.

input.user_request: Generate verification obligations that must hold for the model, such as dimensional accuracy, hole placement, and watertightness.

verification_targets.description: Overall X extent (width) of the completed L-bracket, measured from the global origin at the centre of the bottom face.
verification_targets.notes: Both the horizontal base and the vertical leg are WIDTH_X = 80 mm wide in X, spanning X = -40 to X = +40.

verification_targets.description: Overall Y extent (base leg depth) of the completed L-bracket.
verification_targets.notes: Base leg depth was not stated in the request; inferred as BASE_DEPTH_Y = HEIGHT_Z = 60 mm so the two legs form a symmetric L. Bounding box Y spans -30 to +30.

verification_targets.description: Overall Z extent (height) of the completed L-bracket.
verification_targets.notes: Absolute Z extent from the base bottom plane (Z = 0) to the top edge of the vertical face (Z = 60).

verification_targets.description: The horizontal base and the vertical leg must be fused into exactly one connected solid.
verification_targets.notes: Union of base prism and vertical plate prism; no floating or disjoint bodies.

verification_targets.description: The final solid must be a closed, manifold, water-tight mesh (including the through-hole bore).

functional_requirements: Bracket must be a single rigid right-angle (90 degree) L-shaped part carrying a 10 mm diameter through-hole on the vertical face for fastener mounting.
The through-hole must fully penetrate the vertical plate (through-hole, not blind) so a bolt can pass through.
Overall footprint is defined by width 80 mm, vertical height 60 mm and material thickness 10 mm.
special_features: Through-hole MUST be a single circular hole of MOUNTING_HOLE_DIA = 10 mm (radius MOUNTING_HOLE_RADIUS = 5 mm) on the vertical face; MUST NOT create any additional holes.

Through-hole MUST be positioned MOUNTING_HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET = 20 mm from the top edge of the vertical face and 20 mm from the left vertical edge, i.e. centre at (X = MOUNTING_HOLE_POS_X = -20, Z = MOUNTING_HOLE_POS_Z = 40).
Through-hole MUST penetrate along the Y axis through the full VERTICAL_PLATE_THICKNESS_Y = 10 mm thickness of the vertical face (Cylinder rotated Rot(X=90)), NOT along the Z axis.
Vertical face MUST be WIDTH_X = 80 mm wide (X) and HEIGHT_Z = 60 mm tall (Z) with THICKNESS = 10 mm, and MUST be joined to the horizontal base along a single 90 degree bend at the rear of the base.
Horizontal base MUST be WIDTH_X = 80 mm (X) by BASE_DEPTH_Y = 60 mm (Y) by THICKNESS = 10 mm (Z), occupying Z = 0 to Z = 10 with the centroid of its bottom face at the origin.
Vertical face MUST NOT overhang or extend beyond the base footprint in +Y; its outer face lies at Y = +30 (Y_MAX) with the inner face at Y = +20.
MUST NOT add any features not stated in the request (no fillets, chamfers, counterbores, ribs, lightening cutouts, or extra holes); plain sharp-edged L-bracket only.
The base and vertical leg MUST intersect/union cleanly so the result is a single water-tight solid.
Hole placement in X is asymmetric (20 mm from the left edge only); the hole MUST NOT be duplicated or mirrored to the right edge.
